matching_policy: Exact independently approved identities only; unknown, absent or mismatched fields deny. No fuzzy matching, wildcard, inferred payer/setting or source-label-to-target mapping.

observed_application_context.null_semantics: local_context_id=null and severity_filter=null explicitly mean no selected local context/filter. target_setting_id=null and target_payer_id=null mean unknown; never an applicability wildcard.
observed_application_context.finding: AnalysisContext has no target setting or payer fields. Local context selection does not supply either or change the national analytic population.

A new released catalog pins review/map digests; a separate independently approved allowlist pins released catalog/review/map identities. No self-hash or circular reference. Map revisions invalidate prior applicable release.
